text: 据经济日报，2026年A股市场定向增发延续活跃态势。数据显示，按定增股份上市日计，截至9月29日，年内A股157家公司共实施定增175笔，同比增长48.31％；实际募集资金4654.89亿元，募资规模同比下降39.79％。值得注意的是，年内定增市场募资规模同比下降并非市场降温，而是去年同期基数较高所致。去年仅中国银行、邮储银行、交通银行、建设银行四笔补充资本定增的合计募资金额就高达5200亿元，占当期募资的七成。整体来看，今年以来，定增市场活跃，机构投资者踊跃入场。从定增目的看，定增用于重大资产重组配套融资规模较高。数据显示，年内定增重组有34笔，实际募
text_en: According to Economic Daily, A-share private placements maintained an active trend in 2026. Data shows that, based on the listing date of privately placed shares, as of September 29, 157 A-share companies had implemented 175 private placements during the year, up 48.31% year-on-year; actual funds raised amounted to RMB 465.489 billion, down 39.79% year-on-year. It is worth noting that the year-on-year decline in funds raised in the private placement market this year is not due to a cooling market, but rather due to a high base in the same period last year. Last year alone, four capital replenishment private placements by Bank of China, Postal Savings Bank of China, Bank of Communications and China Construction Bank raised a combined RMB 520 billion, accounting for 70% of fundraising in that period. Overall, since the start of this year, the private placement market has been active, with institutional investors enthusiastically participating. From the perspective of the purpose of private placements, the scale of private placements used for supporting financing in major asset restructurings was relatively high.
